question: Does exact known seed evidence in valid unfinished/crashed canonical history become UNKNOWN_IMPORTED?
evidence: SeedHistory.read accepts real canonical run IDs with a numeric RANDOM/CUSTOM seed without requiring RUN_END.
SeedHistory.finish adds a nonterminal logical identity to open and excludes it from counted finished attempts; linked old terminal copies cannot override an open identity.
Final kind depends only on attempts > 0. With only an eligible open record, attempts=0, kind=UNKNOWN_IMPORTED, deepestFloor=-1.
The existing exactLogicalSegmentsAndCopiedLogsCountOnceAndLatestOpenSegmentIsNotFinished test asserts attempts becomes 0 after latest open segment, but does not assert kind.
The unknown English notice says no matching completed or failed attempt was found, which narrows the user requirement beyond all available persistent history.
RunFactsBuilder records a known seed from canonical RUN_START without an end. A nonterminal run may record DEEPEST_ENTERED; SeedHistory currently reads only terminal DEEPEST.

HeroSelect retains its independent active generated-save duplicate rejection before lookup. It does not reject active custom-seed history or an orphaned crash log. WndRanking Copy invokes the shared lookup directly.
recommended_narrow_scope_before_any_edit: Separate eligible matching-history evidence from finished-attempt count.
An open match must not imply completion, failure, locally generated origin, or creator identity.
Keep exact-ID and ranking-ID deduplication, canonical rollback/latest-segment precedence, conflict checks, redaction/replay/demo exclusions and missing-history behavior.
Clarify completed/unfinished counts and observed depth without substituting an older terminal result for a newer open segment; no scoring activation.
Add a focused canonical unfinished-only classification regression and an open-plus-finished/multiple-segment control after parent approves scope.
